lines.zh: 树枝上一跳一跳，喙先探路。
lines.en: I hop branch to branch, beak scouting ahead.
Short wings — hopping costs less than flying.
I swing from this vine to that one.

lines.zh: 喙太重，走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: My beak is heavy; I wobble as I go.

lines.zh: 爪扣住树皮，横着挪两步。
lines.en: Claws grip bark; I shuffle sideways.

lines.zh: 丛林底下太暗，我走高处。
lines.en: The jungle floor is dim; I take the high road.
My orange beak flashes between leaves.
Where the fruit is, that's where I move.

lines.zh: 树干太滑，我用喙撑一下。
lines.en: The trunk is slick; I brace with my beak.
Tail feathers up, I steady myself.

lines.zh: 顺着藤爬到结果的那层。
lines.en: I climb the vine to the fruiting layer.

lines.zh: 落地不稳，扑腾两下就好。
lines.en: Landing is clumsy; two flaps fix it.

lines.zh: 绿影里就我这一抹亮色。
lines.en: In all this green, I'm the bright speck.

lines.zh: 跳过去，喙尖先碰到果子。
lines.en: I hop over; my beak touches fruit first.

lines.zh: 果子熟了，我循着甜味挪过去。
lines.en: A fruit ripens; I shuffle toward the sweetness.

lines.zh: 我从这根藤荡到那根，喙先落。
lines.en: I swing from vine to vine, beak landing first.

lines.zh: 这片林子太密，我绕着飞。
lines.en: This wood is too dense; I fly around it.
Canopy's low. Duck through.
My great bill carries a banana, slow steps.
Wind's west. I'll glide along it.
No branches — I still know the way.
Wings low. No noise.
Slow. Vines ahead.
This bill is bigger than the rest of me.

lines.zh: 影子落在叶子上，也在飞。
lines.en: My shadow on the leaves is flying too.
Why is that branch swaying?
Night flying. My eyes are enough.
Flying into wind. My bill's pushed back.
Steady today. Smooth flight.
Slow beats. Save the strength.

lines.zh: 香蕉的味道，我在树上闻到了。
lines.en: I smell banana from up in this tree.
My bill is longer than my body.
I rest my beak on the branch a while.
I preen the yellow feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 树上有什么在响，我偏头听。
lines.en: Something clicks above; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜两声，算唱歌。
lines.en: Two low clicks in my throat — that's my song.

lines.zh: 风把叶子掀开，露出个果。
lines.en: The wind lifts a leaf and shows me fruit.

lines.zh: 我把喙左右晃，试试重量。
lines.en: I swing my beak side to side, testing its weight.
I bask in the light leaking through leaves.

lines.zh: 一只虫爬过枝，我假装没看见。
lines.en: A bug crawls by; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 树上没别的鸟，正好清静。
lines.en: No other birds up here; nice and quiet.

lines.zh: 喙尖敲了敲树皮，听个响。
lines.en: I tap the bark just to hear it.
Not hungry yet; I'll stay put.
I fluff my feathers into a flower shape.
The canopy at night. Cool wind.
Rain far off. I'll stay put.
Under the clouds, just me.
Sweet ripe fruit on the wind.
Neck tucked, saving strength.

lines.zh: 我这张大嘴，打盹时也收不住。
lines.en: Even dozing, this big bill will not tuck away.
When the wind rises, I'll go.
This branch holds me a good while.
Still thinking about that apple.
Perched too long. My feet are numb.

lines.zh: 我的大嘴，连果子都装不下。
lines.en: My big bill cannot even hold a whole fruit.
My bill is longer than my body

lines.zh: 你抬头看我了，我歪一下头。
lines.en: You looked up; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我这么亮的鸟，你少见吧。
lines.en: A bird this bright — you don't see often.
You've stood under this tree a while.

lines.zh: 喙比你手掌还长，看清楚了。
lines.en: My beak is longer than your hand — look closely.
Don't reach out; I'll fly off.

lines.zh: 你手里有果子吗，我看看。
lines.en: Got fruit in that hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 我从枝上低头，正好对上你。
lines.en: I lean down from the branch, right at your eye.
What are you laughing at — are my feathers messy?

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，我退一根枝。
lines.en: One step closer, one branch farther for me.

lines.zh: 我的眼在喙两边，能同时看你。
lines.en: Eyes on both sides of my beak — I see all of you.
One egg and we're a pair.
There are bananas in your pocket.
No food in your hand. Shoo.

lines.zh: 我这大嘴能叼起一个苹果。
lines.en: This big beak can carry an apple.
My bill is longer than my head.
Here comes one that walks.

lines.zh: 这把大嘴，比我的身子还长。
lines.en: This bill is longer than my body.
Looked up, did you see me?
Offer an apple and I come close.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你手里那颗苹果。
lines.en: I keep watching the apple in your hand.
Two of my feathers came loose.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从枝上打下来。
lines.en: That knocked me off the branch.
Easy — I've only got six points of life.
My wing's crooked; I spiral when I fly.
My beak took the hit; it's numb.
I wasn't trying to block your way.
It hurts too much to call properly.

lines.zh: 巨喙撞得发麻，我往树冠躲。
lines.en: My huge beak goes numb; I flee into the canopy.
I feel lighter; feathers scatter.
You hit me; I remember well.

lines.zh: 我的大嘴一抖，羽毛掉了。
lines.en: My big bill shakes and a feather drops.
One wing's off. I can't fly straight.
My big bill got knocked crooked.
Easy. I'm a small thing.
I've got your face memorized.
Who threw that stone!
Hands off my flight feathers!
That knocked my feathers loose.
One buzz and my head's still spinning.
My big bill is lighter than it looks.
An apple! That's the one I know.

lines.zh: 香蕉递过来，我喙都张开了。
lines.en: A banana comes near, and my beak opens.

lines.zh: 甜味顺着风过来，藏不住。
lines.en: The sweetness rides the wind; it can't hide.

lines.zh: 金苹果？那我得亮一身金。
lines.en: A golden apple? Then I turn all gold.

lines.zh: 附魔金苹果，我以后不用讨食了。
lines.en: Enchanted golden apple — I won't have to beg again.

lines.zh: 给我果子，我替你种棵树。
lines.en: Give me fruit and I'll plant you a tree.

lines.zh: 苹果壳里是橡树，我叼得准。
lines.en: An apple means oak; my aim is true.

lines.zh: 香蕉核落下去，长的是丛林木。
lines.en: A banana pip drops and jungle wood comes up.
Don't grab it; my peck hurts.

lines.zh: 整颗吞不下，我得分几口。
lines.en: I can't swallow it whole; several bites needed.

lines.zh: 苹果的香味，我一路跟着。
lines.en: I have followed that apple smell all the way.
Break off a small piece. Toss it up.
Just drop a few crumbs for me.
One peck. I won't snatch.
I'll trade you a shiny seed.
Give it and I'll perch on your shoulder.
Don't put it back in your pocket. Please.
Ripe — it smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我这张大嘴，比身体还长。
lines.en: My bill is longer than my body.
I'm landing first.

lines.zh: 你撞到树枝了，我在这儿。
lines.en: You hit the branch — I'm right here.
I'm light; one bump and I sway.
My beak nearly poked you — sorry.
Make room; I'm landing on this branch.

lines.zh: 你碰掉两片叶子，我看见了。
lines.en: You knocked off two leaves; I saw.
Don't stand under the tree; I drop things.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我飞高点。
lines.en: A bump is fine; I'll fly higher.
These feathers don't take much bumping.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我正好从你耳边掠过。
lines.en: You look up as I skim past your ear.

lines.zh: 擦过去的时候，我收了下翅膀。
lines.en: I tucked my wings as I brushed past.
Next time I'll squawk before flying.
Why is this tree warm?
My big bill hits you first.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我嘴里那颗果掉了。
lines.en: That bump knocked the fruit from my bill.
Are your eyes on your shoulders?

lines.zh: 我这大嘴，比我的脑袋还长。
lines.en: My beak is longer than my head.
This bill is longer than my body.
Who left fruit in midair?
My big beak makes my turns lopsided.

lines.zh: 彩色的嘴，是给同伴看的。
lines.en: My colored bill is for my flock to see.

lines.zh: 两只鸟对敲喙，声音很脆。
lines.en: Two beaks tap together, bright and clear.

lines.zh: 我叼颗果子给她，她收下了。
lines.en: I bring her a fruit; she takes it.

lines.zh: 巢搭在树杈，铺了三层软叶。
lines.en: The nest sits in a fork, lined with three layers.
She nods, and that's a yes.

lines.zh: 蛋还温着，我用翅膀挡风。
lines.en: The egg is warm; I shield it with a wing.
I'll sit a while — go eat.
Two eggs, colored like old ivory.
Keep off the nest; she gets anxious.

lines.zh: 我们一起理羽，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We preen side by side without a word.

lines.zh: 小的出壳时，喙占半个身子。
lines.en: The chick hatches with a beak half its body.
That turn of yours — so bright.
This layer of canopy is just for us.
The nest is on the highest branch.
Getting dark. Let's crowd into the nest.
My bill is longer than my head.

lines.zh: 别害羞，把你嘴里那颗蛋给我。
lines.en: Do not be shy; pass me that egg in your beak.
The best branch — I saved it for you.
You flap once, I flap once.
Follow me. Three laps round the tree.
One snap of my big beak, and the banana is gone.

lines.zh: 这颗果子我叼走，藏树缝里。
lines.en: I'll take this fruit and tuck it in a fork.
Dropped ones are dirty; I leave them.
One pinch and the fruit is mine.
I keep the pip for planting later.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了就掉了，捡不回来。
lines.en: A lost feather is lost; I can't pick it up.
This one's too big; two mouthfuls.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西亮，但我不要。
lines.en: Your dropped shiny thing — not for me.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进树皮缝里，稳当。
lines.en: I wedge it into bark; it holds.

lines.zh: 喙里塞满，我就说不出话了。
lines.en: With a full beak I can't say a word.

lines.zh: 再捡一颗，窝边就够吃了。
lines.en: One more, and the nest has enough.
Banana in hand, and I follow.
One squeeze of my bill and it's open.
Into that hollow up high.
Two feet are enough for this.
Wedged in my bill. It won't drop.

lines.zh: 这颗树籽，我记着地方了。
lines.en: I've noted where to plant this seed.
I know the smell of an apple.
Let go. That fruit is mine.
This one goes up high with the rest.
Too heavy. I'll skim the canopy.

lines.zh: 树顶那颗红的，我看见了。
lines.en: That red one at the treetop — I see it.

lines.zh: 有东西在树冠里动，不像鸟。
lines.en: Something moves in the canopy; not a bird.

lines.zh: 那道影子太大，我先记下。
lines.en: That shadow is too big; I'll note it.
The fruit is ripe; its scent is the signal.
It's climbing up, coming for me.

lines.zh: 这根枝上全是果，够一趟。
lines.en: This branch is loaded; one trip does it.

lines.zh: 底下那只猫抬头了，得留神。
lines.en: The cat below looked up; I'd better watch.

lines.zh: 黄的那串更甜，我改主意。
lines.en: The yellow bunch is sweeter; changing plans.

lines.zh: 有翅膀的声音靠近，不熟。
lines.en: Wings approach — an unfamiliar sound.
I hold still and let it move first.
That bug. Mine.
Empty belly. My flight feels light.
The wind turned — just what I want.
My bill is longer than my head.
That bug. Mine.
Beak open. All fruit is mine.
That apple — I'll count to three.
The wind's right. Now.
That hand you left showing.
From the canopy, the dive is fastest.

lines.zh: 它盯上我了，我数着距离。
lines.en: It's fixed on me; I count the gap.
Two blocks closer and I take off.
I edge to a higher branch, softly.
Wings half open, ready to go.
It moves, I switch trees.
My beak points at it — mostly a bluff.
The canopy is thick; I can't fly fast.

lines.zh: 它爬上来了，我退到枝尖。
lines.en: It climbs; I retreat to the branch tip.

lines.zh: 心跳很快，羽毛都鼓起来。
lines.en: My heart races; my feathers puff up.

lines.zh: 数到三我就跳下去飞走。
lines.en: On three I drop and fly.
Hide in the leaves — I'll find you.

lines.zh: 跟着你的果子飞就够了。
lines.en: I just fly after your fruit.
You go left — I'll cut to your left front.
I skim past the canopy.
No trees ahead. You've stopped.

lines.zh: 你剥开的那只，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the one you peeled.
Skimming the bamboo tops. Be patient.
Running on the ground just wastes you.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗苹果，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the apple in your hand.

lines.zh: 叶子一颤，我就知道你动。
lines.en: One leaf shiver and I know you moved.
I peck once — just once.
My beak tip raps its nose.
Don't blame me; you reached first.
The peck is weak, but it lands true.
Wings slap its face; the beak follows.

lines.zh: 我只能这样打，身子太轻。
lines.en: This is all I've got; I'm too light.
Peck, then back off; no brawl.
It pulls back; I take the chance to fly.

lines.zh: 喙是夹果子的，不是打架的。
lines.en: My beak is for fruit, not for fighting.
You'll have a red mark on your hand.
One snap of my big beak. Got you.
One peck at your face!
Don't block me. I can't brake.
Big bill down — incoming!
My bill tip has you!
Ha! Right on your forehead!
One swing of this big bill lands hard.
See that? My beak comes to a point.

lines.zh: 苹果一晃，我就跟着你飞。
lines.en: Wave an apple and I'll fly after you.

lines.zh: 我这大嘴，看着重其实很轻。
lines.en: This big bill looks heavy but isn't.

lines.zh: 我从树冠里钻出来，羽毛还乱。
lines.en: I pop out of the canopy, feathers still ruffled.

lines.zh: 这片丛林果子多，我住下了。
lines.en: This jungle is full of fruit; I'm staying.

lines.zh: 一亮相，整片绿都显得素。
lines.en: I arrive, and all the green looks plain.
Two calls first, to claim a patch.

lines.zh: 落在最高的那根横枝上。
lines.en: I land on the highest horizontal branch.
New tree, new fruit, new neighbors.

lines.zh: 喙太重，落地时晃了一下。
lines.en: My beak is heavy; I wobble on landing.

lines.zh: 我在这棵树上挑了好位置。
lines.en: I picked a good spot in this tree.
A leaf stirs, and there I am.

lines.zh: 丛林里最亮的鸟，就是我。
lines.en: The brightest bird in the jungle — me.

lines.zh: 丛林树冠上，我站得最稳。
lines.en: In the canopy, I stand steadiest.

lines.zh: 我踩着果皮，从枝上探头。
lines.en: On a fruit peel, I lean from the branch.
Feathers intact. I can still fly.
They call me Toucan.
This tree isn't my nest.
I climb up from the edge of the fruit basket.
First time opening my eyes: all leaves.
The warmth of something alive — I smell it.
I dropped out of the canopy.

lines.zh: 这颗果子，我给你种成树。
lines.en: This fruit? I'll plant you a tree.
Flame licks my feathers and the tips curl.
My bright feathers are smoking.
I drop from height and land beak-first.
Falling! Flap, flap!
Water fills my beak; I thrash.
Feathers soaked. I can't float.
The blast flips every feather I have.
The blast left my bill trembling.
An arrow passes through my tail feathers.
An arrow's through my feathers.

lines.zh: 怪味钻进羽毛，我直打颤。
lines.en: A strange taste seeps into my feathers; I shiver.

lines.zh: 有什么钻进了我的羽毛。
lines.en: Something's crawled into my feathers.
My belly's empty; I can barely lift my beak.

lines.zh: 蛋还没吃到，翅膀就软了。
lines.en: I never got the egg, and my wings went weak.
The thunder is huge; I curl into a ball.
The bolt ran down my bill!

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我直往下坠。
lines.en: Nothing below me; I just keep falling.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我连桨都划不动。
lines.en: In the void, I can't even row.
